changes.review: The corollary now opens with the line-search range it needs, "For every fixed pair 0<c_1<=1/3, c_1<c_2<1" (M32(b), the corollary after the induction (26)); nothing else changed. Its coverage theorem Failure.failure_polyhedral already quantified over exactly this range, so the correspondence holds and is now literal.

The theorem no longer fixes c_1=10^-4, c_2=1/2: one objective and one family of starts with H_0=I give the same runs and decisions for every fixed pair 0<c_1<=1/3, c_1<c_2<1 (M6), and "the same" now says what it compares, "infinite full-BFGS runs, the same for every such pair" (M41, R-A-18(d)). NegativeLower.local_failure_lower states this uniform version with the objective and starts chosen before the pair, from LUniform.uniformSmoothLocalFailure.

The lemma now asserts the implementation "for every admissible pair (c_1,c_2)" (M6), says that the eigenvalues are those of the derivative at P_* (M38, R-F-3), and writes 0.038, 0.039 for .038, .039 (M39, R-F-12); the values are unchanged. LowerCurvature.lower_hyperbolic states one neighborhood for all admissible pairs (through LNormalizedOracle.uniform_conditions_eventually) and the spectrum of the derivative at P_*.
Typesetting only: the formula F:R^2->R is braced so that it cannot break across a line (M39, R-D-4); the statement is unchanged and Local.planar_max states it.

changes.review: The proposition, stated on 13 October for every admissible pair instead of c_1=10^-4, c_2=1/2 (Lean review), now chooses the initial state before the pair, so one run serves every 0<c_1<=1/3, c_1<c_2<1 (M6), and also puts the initial point in V (M33); the range is typeset unbreakably (M39). LowerCurvature.quadratic_failure_initial_point, from LUniform.uniform_global_failure, states the corrected proposition with this quantifier order; quadratic_failure keeps the statement without the initial point.

The qualifier of the query bounds is set off by \quad (M1), [z]_2 is defined as the second coordinate (M2), the query list is asserted only for 0<c_1<=1/3 and c_2>0, without which the lemma is false (M11), and "the three starting points" are now the base points z_0,z_1,z_2 (M38, R-E-9(b)). Failure.seed_cycle states the corrected lemma for this range, and Failure.seed_cycle_range_counterexample (c_1=0.38) shows the range is needed.
Layout only: the two closure identities are set on two lines in a gathered environment (M39, displays (44)-(46)); they are unchanged and SeedCertificate.closure_identity states both.

The subgradient bound G is renamed Lambda, since G is the seed maximum (M3), and the end-of-proof mark now closes this last display of the proof (M39). The inequality N^2<=max{2M,4 Lambda R/theta}T is unchanged up to the name and Global.inward_to_radial states it.

Renaming only (M3): the return factor r=(M_3)_11 is now hat-rho and the shape coordinates (b,e) are (zeta,eta), which removes clashes with the scale ratio r=1/128 and the scalar parameter b of the same appendix. The map is the same; LowerCurvature.return_map_def unfolds LNormalizedReturn.returnMap to it.
Punctuation only: the display ends with a comma, since the sentence continues after it (M39, R-F-7); the substep formulas are unchanged and LowerCurvature.return_substep_def states them.

The range (v!=0, 0<=tau<=1) moved from the display into the sentence before it, "for v!=0 and 0<=tau<=1,", so that equation (1) has no qualifier on its own line (M39, R-A-12). The identity and its range are unchanged; Geometry.mixed_inward_remainder states it under these hypotheses.
Layout only: the three enclosures of the query box are set on two lines in a gathered environment (M39, displays (44)-(46)); the intervals are unchanged and SeedCertificate.query_box states them.
Layout only: the three certified inequalities are set on two lines in a gathered environment (M39, displays (44)-(46)); they are unchanged and SeedCertificate.root_arithmetic states them.
Spacing only: the qualifier is set off by \quad, so that "|g_i^Tz|<3 (i=0,1,2)" no longer renders as the product "3(i=0,1,2)" (M1); the bounds are unchanged and Failure.seed_query_bounds states them.
Typesetting only: the stray control space before the membership sign is removed (M39, R-F-13(c)); the rational enclosures of 10^10 J are unchanged and LowerCurvature.shape_certificate states them.
Spacing only: the qualifier is set off by \quad, so that "a_l/2 (i=0,1,2)" no longer renders as a product (M1); the local model is unchanged and Failure.upper_local_model states it.

The caption gives the vertical-to-horizontal ratios of the three panels, 22/4.6, 2.5/4.2 and 23/21, instead of "as indicated" (M39, R-E-6). This describes the rendering only; the figure stays a non-claim illustration whose facts are covered by other register items.

The table uses booktabs rules (M4) and ragged-right columns (M39), its last column is headed "At the minimizer" instead of "At the accumulation point" (M30), and its caption says that both regimes hold for every fixed 0<c_1<=1/3, c_1<c_2<1 (M6). The rows and caption still restate Theorems art:local-failure and art:local-failure-lower, whose coverage theorems state them for that range.

The caption now says that the decisions are those of the specified search for every 0<c_1<=1/3 and c_2>0 (M11); without that range the Decision column is false (the row (2,1/16) fails Armijo for c_1=0.38, Failure.seed_cycle_range_counterexample). Failure.trial_table states the table with this range.

One sentence is added: every queried point in the construction is differentiable, so the weak-Wolfe test, which needs the gradient at the trial point, is always defined (M34, R-E-10); the specified search is unchanged. The new item A/failure/prose/071 restates the differentiability of every query proved for the seed run (Failure.cone_orbit_scaling, SeedOrbit.coercive_strict_active) and in the theorems of both local constructions.

The Lipschitz step now cuts segments into pieces shorter than a Lebesgue number of the cover and takes the largest local constant (M41, R-C-6), the inward condition names theta=1/2 for every band next to M=L max||r_x||^2 (M34, R-C-5), and an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). The argument is unchanged; Global.uniform_lipschitz_gradient and centered_inward_condition state the two steps and Global.centered the theorem.

The proof now cites (art:visibility)-(art:transport), including the visibility bound it uses, instead of starting at (art:secant-control) (M35, R-B-9), writes the budget display as m Pbar^-1 sum q_k^-1 (M38, R-B-11), and ends with an end-of-proof mark (M39). The argument is unchanged; Energy.certificate_step_general and certificate_reciprocal_budget state its step and the changed display.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and still corresponds to the library steps of this proof item and to Failure.failure_polyhedral.

The proof now defines Gram_H(g,Z) and Gram_H(g,y,Z) before using them, writes (r-z)det A, calls Z an orthogonal matrix with A^-1=Z^T H^-1 Z and says that the right side of (art:compression-determinant) vanishes (M38, R-B-1, R-B-3, R-B-4); it ties rho=alpha/(beta q) to the compression through Z^Tv=a and credits the Schur complement only with u<=q, u>=0 coming from A>0 (M34, R-B-2); end-of-proof mark (M39). The mathematics is unchanged; MatrixAlgebra.gram_schur states the Schur display and MatrixAlgebra.gram_compression the lemma.

Theorem art:centered is now applied with all its parameters, x_*=0, U=R^n, psi=0 and gamma=F, and the radial route is introduced by "Alternatively" instead of "Equivalently" (M41, R-C-10); an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). The argument is unchanged; Global.homogeneous_via_radial states the alternative route and Global.homogeneous the theorem.

Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and the three cases are still Global.homogeneous_examples_norm, homogeneous_examples_gauge and homogeneous_examples_maxLinear.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Local.local_centered states the corollary it proves.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the construction is unchanged and NegativeUpper.local_failure states the theorem it proves.

The sphere gap omega is renamed delta, since the article reserves omega for 1-c_2 (M3), and an end-of-proof mark is added (M39); the argument is unchanged. Local.localization_sphere_min and localization_radial_lower state its two displays with delta, and Local.localization the lemma.

LNormalizedOracle.uniform_conditions_eventually gives the uniform decisions, and LowerCurvature.shape_map_def, characteristic_signs and return_block_form state the changed definitions and displays.

The citation of Lemma art:gram-compression now says that it is in Appendix A (M35, R-B-8), and an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). The argument is unchanged; Energy.minor_hierarchy states the theorem, and its Lean proof (the library's principalMinorHierarchy) uses the library's compression bound BFGSCompression.compressed_inverseBFGS_bound_generic where the text cites Lemma art:gram-compression, which MatrixAlgebra.gram_compression states.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Global.mixed_benchmark states the corollary it proves.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Local.nonradial_example states the theorem it proves.

The field estimates are now applied to eligible pairs with d<=1, the range in which Lemma art:planar-field gives lambda^2<=1+Ld, and the proof states s_k->0 and d_k->0 before using them on the tail (M34, R-D-1); an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). The Lean proof already uses these facts (AdmissibleBFGSRun.steps_tendsto_zero_of_strict_contour), and Local.planar_cluster states the theorem.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Local.planar_convergence states the corollary it proves.

Symbols that clashed with the lemma's own are renamed: e, a, b, L and [a,b] become hat-s, bar-g, bar-h, M and [0,1], with grad f_i(x), grad f_j(x) written out (M3); the segment parameter, exp and the numerator of D'/D are explained (M38, M41), phi'(0)=-d is kept on one line, an end-of-proof mark is added (M39), and the citation of Bogosel no longer repeats his name (M40). No step changed; PlanarGeometry.transversality_limits, branch_cocoercivity, crossing_pairings and crossing_step_bound state the renamed displays.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Local.planar_max states the corollary it proves.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Local.plq states the corollary it proves.

The ball radius r is renamed rho (M38, R-D-3(c)), the inward condition is given with its constants, M=L rho^2 and theta=1/2 for every band (M34, R-C-5), and an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). The argument is unchanged; Local.polyhedral_inward_taylor states the Taylor display with rho, ConvexCellRadial.local_cells_inward the inward condition and PositivePartition.polyhedral the theorem.

The proof adds the initial-point map w->tau z to the maps that vanish at P_*, so that the initial point and every physical query lie in V (M33), and notes that neither the neighborhood nor the chosen point depends on (c_1,c_2), so one run serves every admissible pair (M6). Renamings and wording: hat-rho, (zeta,eta) (M3), the returns w_m introduced (M38), "exceeds min Q_mu" (M41), Dyatlov's citation (M40), end-of-proof mark (M39). LowerCurvature.quadratic_failure_initial_point, from LUniform.orbit_exists and LFlatten.physical_neighborhood, states the corrected proposition.

The proof now reduces the inward case to the radial one by Theorem art:radial-equivalence and checks that eligible pairs in K_eta have F(z)<F(x) and T=t>0 before applying the radial condition (M34, R-C-1); an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). Global.radial_band_certificate states the certificate and Global.radial_convergence the corollary under either condition, so the correspondence holds.

G is renamed Lambda (M3); the subgradient bound is credited to the proof of Theorem art:certificate and the unused Lipschitz clause is dropped (M35, M41, R-C-2, R-C-3); the case split now states the inward model at z evaluated at z-tau r_z, the reversed pair's numerator (g-h)^T r_x=T-N>=|N| and the choice tau=theta (M34, R-C-4); an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). The estimate is unchanged; RadialCertificate.radialNumerator_swap states the added identity (g-h)^T r_x=T-N, Global.curvature_eq_errors the identity T=D_F(z,x)+D_F(x,z) that the case split uses, and Global.radial_equivalence the theorem.

The gradient bound G is renamed Lambda (M3); beta_k is now defined in the display, beta_k=-y_k^T H_k g_k/q_k=t_k/d_k>=omega, and the weighted contraction is used for k>=J only (M34, R-B-5); an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). Energy.run_bounds and potential_contraction state the two changed displays and Energy.reciprocal_growth the theorem.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Energy.reference_energy states the lemma it proves.

Layout only: display (art:root_arithmetic) is set on two lines and an end-of-proof mark is added (M39); the certificate argument is unchanged and SeedCertificate.root_certificate states the lemma it proves.
Only an end-of-proof mark was added (M39, R-C-11); the argument is unchanged and Energy.run_invariants states the lemma it proves.

The proof now names the first update B(I,g_0,g_1,1)=M_1, says that the identities hold at an arbitrary point, not only the root, and adds that the steps satisfy s_j=-alpha_j M_j g_j with alpha=(1,1/4,1/16) (M38, R-E-9); it gives the projected term Pi(C+beta E)Pi=rho~ Pi and the rank-one term rho~(I-Pi) (M34, R-E-3), corrects "its denominators" (M41), sets (art:closure_identity) on two lines and adds an end-of-proof mark (M39). The algebra is unchanged; SeedCycle.first_update, middle_update and Failure.seed_matrices_steps state the named steps.

Convexity is now derived from the second derivative, nonnegative on every piece (a positive multiple of P_b' on the positive intervals; 6, -6x and 0 outside them), not from the sign of the first derivative (M34, R-E-4); an end-of-proof mark is added (M39). Failure.positive_interval_derivatives gives the second derivative on the positive intervals and Failure.upper_scalar_lemma states the lemma.

The copy step now chooses one seed orbit whose initial point and queries all lie in the local-model neighborhood, the same for every admissible pair (M33, M6), starts the copies at l>=1, the range of (art:lower_local_model) (M41, R-F-8), and applies the local model at the initial point too (M33); a formula is kept on one line (M39). LowerCurvature.copy_runs_from_one, copy_transfer (at every step, the start included) and copy_limits state the corrected steps.

The qualifier (k!=i) is set off by \quad (M1), the query box is set on two lines (M39), and the second coordinate of q is written [q]_2, as in Lemma art:seed_cycle (M38, R-E-9(a)); the certificate argument is unchanged. SeedCertificate.gapExpr, query_box and seed_query_bounds_certificate state the changed lines.

Wording only: "with equality zero at the origin" becomes "and F(0)=0" (M41, R-F-11); compact sublevels and the unique minimizer follow as before, and LowerCurvature.lower_objective_minimizer states them.

The induction (26) is now introduced "For every fixed pair 0<c_1<=1/3, c_1<c_2<1", the range in which the seed decisions hold (M32(b), the M11 range at a further place); the induction itself is unchanged, and the changed lead-in lines lie in no register item; display item A/failure/disp/010 carries the range (its note records M32). Failure.cone_orbit states it for exactly this range.
Spacing only, inside display (art:upper_local_model): the qualifier (i=0,1,2) is set off by \quad (M1); the passage is otherwise unchanged and Failure.upper_local_model states the display.

The two constant-derivative lengths are now said to lie below and above the node b a_l, and for l=0 the plateau is credited to the affine outer extension (M41, R-F-9); the numbers and display (art:lower_plateau) are unchanged. LowerCurvature.lower_plateau_lengths_bi and lower_plateau_bi state them for every l, l=0 included.

Table 1's caption now requires, besides compact sublevels, a centered representation on all of R^2 for global convergence of u^2+|v| (M31(a), a further place of M7), row 3 adds "unique minimizer" to lambda>0 (M31(b)), and the layout and two terms change, "where the representation holds" and "admissible runs" (M39, R-A-13). The rows still restate the theorems they cite, now with their hypotheses, and Geometry.benchmark_centered_global (new) proves the caption.

In Chapter 13, "fail to be twice differentiable at the accumulation point" becomes "at the minimizer", the point 0 where the copies accumulate (M30, companion recurrence, a logged module-L transformation); the claim is unchanged and Ch13L.branch_regularity states it at the minimizer.

The research story now says that three of the four C^{1,1} branches lose second differentiability, and at the minimizer rather than at the accumulation point (M8, companion recurrence, with the M30 phrase; a direct edit). It restates Chapter 1's N2 summary, which Ch13L.branch_regularity and Ch01I.n2_four_branch_version prove.

The scope remark now says that the homogeneous value alternatives "conclude objective-value convergence without any conclusion about the iterates", instead of "value convergence does not imply bounded iterates", which read as an unestablished claim, and the next clause follows with "they do not subsume" (W39). The remark stays a non-claim about scope (C/research_story/prose/017), and the statement that Xie-Waechter's finite detection is not subsumed, now with the alternatives as its subject, is unchanged in substance (C/research_story/prose/018, SAME_AS C/07_H/prose/044, Ch07H.two_piece_finite_termination).

The passage now says that three of the four lower-curvature branches lose second differentiability at zero, not all of them (M8; the fourth is a quadratic), and introduces the whitening as the fixed change of coordinates x=Az, A=(H_0^seed)^{1/2}, of Appendix D, to which "after that change" (before "after whitening") also refers (M38, R-A-4). Verification.lower_active_gradients, whitened_active_gradients and lower_branch_second_differentiability state the changed sentences.

The ray identity now carries its range, G(t(-1,16))=-t for t>=0, as in Section 6 (M9); without it the identity is false for t<0. Verification.seed_ray states it and seed_ray_fails_at_minus_one shows that the range is needed.

"At every scale" becomes "at infinitely many shrinking scales" (M41, R-A-11): the wrong vertices recur at the scales a_l->0 of the two local embeddings. The sentence restates their theorems (NegativeUpper.local_failure, NegativeLower.local_failure_lower).

"Along the certified perturbed orbit" becomes "Along the perturbed orbit of Proposition art:quadratic_failure", which names the orbit meant (M41, R-A-11), and the record's scope review says "The perturbed orbit of Proposition art:quadratic_failure" instead of "The certified orbit"; the claim is unchanged and Verification.perturbed_orbit_secants states it.
changes.scope_review: Subtract the existing actual endpoint gradients mu*x+g_i and mu*(x+s)+g_j to obtain y=mu*s+(g_j-g_i). The perturbed orbit of Proposition art:quadratic_failure changes among distinct fixed slopes; its convergence implies s tends to zero. This describes that orbit, not a generic switching failure.

changes.review: The abstract now restricts the centered theorem to compact initial sublevels contained in the region of the centered representation (M7), names coercive max-linear functions, norms and gauges (M41, R-A-18(c)), says that in the curved-interface example moving comparison geometry proves convergence although the radial criterion fails (M5), and that three of the four C^{1,1} branches lose second differentiability at the minimizer (M8, M30). Each sentence restates corrected theorems (SAME_AS items), and Master.centered_representation_needs_containment shows that the containment is needed.

"The next theorem" becomes Theorem art:reciprocal-growth, the theorem meant (the next one is the minor hierarchy), and the bounded gradients it needs are stated (M10). Energy.reciprocal_sum_superlinear_of_minimizer states the corrected sentence.

The sentence on the equal negative pairing now cites the left panel of Figure art:gradient-geometry (M35, R-A-10), and the range v!=0, 0<=tau<=1 of the inward-remainder identity moves from the display into the sentence before it (M39, R-A-12). The claims are unchanged; Geometry.equal_negative_pairing and mixed_inward_remainder state them.
